steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Even broken materials like these continue to thirst and scream.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Ah, I can hear your wails...

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Morning, Sesa. Been busy all night again?

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: I thought I heard a bunch of mercenaries fighting. Turned out it's just you taking out the trash.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Time does not forgive!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Great power must be tempered by years...

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: In order to break free from the shackles of pain and destruction, right?

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Haha, always so hard to understand what you're saying.

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I am not your antidote, and you need not thank me for this act of impulse.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Is this... did you make this out of that scrap?!

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Just like that? Incredible!

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: This old leg of mine hasn't moved so well in... forever! Wow!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Just gave it a few tweaks.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: May it solve some of your troubles.

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: You're too humble.

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Thank you so much, Sesa.

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Look out behind you!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: It is perilous to keep one's gaze lowered and lose sight of all around you.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: No idea what you just said!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: But it doesn't matter!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Here, Sesa!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Bread?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Yeah! I got it from a guy who wears weird clothes and talks weird.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Heh, I got two, actually.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: So one's for you. Thanks for catching that thief!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: (Swallows)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What is it?!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (There's a note in the bread?)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (Someone who dresses and speaks oddly... could it be?)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Little one?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: (Swallows) Mm?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Come, reveal your secrets. Who has guided you here...

steps.name: Aging Resident
steps.text: Sesa?
Are you Mr. Sesa?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: No need for titles. I am beneath them.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: The aura of a profiteer, that chilling accent...
I beg your pardon?
Er, has there been a misunderstanding?
The name's Darrell. I'm a merchant from Columbia.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (A merchant from Columbia?)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (Could the note have been a warning?)

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I've been told you're an expert on retrofitting Originium weapons.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Whisper) I have a shipment of... said weapons... from a certain Columbian company.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Whisper) Would you like to have a... chat?

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: I thought this would be a place where I could catch my breath, compared to all the crap in Ursus.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: Yes, I was a killer! But I only ever killed that blasted drunkard in the search squad, dammit!

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: I just want to live a quiet life and take care of my new wife.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: I've even tried to stop thinking about the scum who reported me, about what they did to me!

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: But why...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What would you like me to do for you, then?

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: A few Ursus mercenaries recognized me. I denied it, but they burned down my shop...

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: The Lord Ameer's men chased them away, but... I know they've set their sights on me.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Why did you come to me, then?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What drove you to forfeit your own rights?

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: Rights?

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: I know you can find them.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But you could have done it yourself.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Am I wrong? Are you suddenly beset by pity for your fellow man?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: To my knowledge, it wasn't just some 'search squad member' you killed in Ursus.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: You!

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I'll consider this a sign of your mistrust in me. A test, as it were.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But see, you clearly know what you want, don't you?

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: That said, that weapon of yours isn't exactly suitable for revenge.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What can you give me?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I'll accept all reasonable forms of payment, even... interesting conditions.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: Goodbye.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I could help you.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm just looking for a purpose.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: A purpose?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Yes, a purpose.

steps.name: Timid Resident
steps.text: Thanks, but no.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: This is rather unlike you. I thought you'd have come earlier.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Or even barged in, rather than standing there like a student waiting for his teacher's answer.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Of course, I could consider taking in a student like you.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Give you some necessary pointers, if that's what you're looking for.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I do need an answer.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: That note. You're the only one who could've sent it.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I don't know the child.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But I do 'know' them.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I was handing out bread to every child on the streets who passed by, knowing the message would make it to you.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I was asking why, not how.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Did you think you were clever, following and using a child?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I was simply... matching my behavior to yours.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: The caution and wariness you've shown in Sargon... You must be hiding from someone.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: The less traces one leaves, the harder it will be for someone to find out.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Can you talk normally for once?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Who, me?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: A merchant who says he's from Columbia, claiming to have experimental weapons from that company.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Did you think I'd believe it's a coincidence? What do you want?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: It's been many years. Have you found a single thing?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: This isn't the first time you've done something like this.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Are you having fun?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: You give me a piece of intel, then watch me blunder around and end up empty-handed.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But you'll keep searching. Because vengeance is the eternal motif.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: How far will you go?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Also, you shouldn't get the wrong idea.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I wanted to help you, and to help myself as well.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Did you accept his offer?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: No, I told him I wasn't interested.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I turned him down and told him to never come back.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What a surprising result. I was sure you'd gladly accept it...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Did you not trust his identity? Or did you suspect my motives?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What can you give me?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I'll accept all reasonable forms of payment, even... interesting conditions.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Alright. But no more conditions. You've already named your price.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: You said you wanted a purpose.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I'll give you one.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Deal.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: So, what do you know?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: He's not a merchant. Everything he said was a clumsy lie.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Even I could see that. That's why I found him suspicious.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: But you knew that and still sent him to me. You must have your reasons.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: He showed me a weapon sample from Columbia.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: It was... interesting.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: The Originium Arts mechanism was more direct than any other product in the black market.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Do you mean...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Compared to your research, the technology used was crude, immature.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But someone is trying to pick a lock which should not be opened.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: No one should see a single page of that documentation ever again, much less sell it on the black market.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: It's a valuable lead.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Or perhaps bait. A trap.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Yes, the perfect bait for me. One that I couldn't resist.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Brother...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: May I ask what your plans are now?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I cannot say.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: What about making a new deal?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: You'll need my help in the black markets of Sargon.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: No, I would rather place my faith in inspired intuition, rather than the guided hand.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: The hidden truth will be revealed.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Ah... what a shame.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: How long are you gonna take? I've never seen someone so picky in my life!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Ealayk allaena!

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: What's that attitude? Ibn al kalb!

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: Do you really think any of this crap you're selling is anything but scrap metal?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Say that again?! I'll tear you to pieces, I swear!

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: Try me! Haram alayk, I wouldn't have wasted my time here if a friend didn't recommend it.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Al'ahmaq!

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: Who're you?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You again!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: All that is sold here is emptiness.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Small wonder no gazes linger.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Just my luck, what a day!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: First a fool, now a madman.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Get lost!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Haha, do you not see the weakness and frailty in his weapons?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: The imposition of will can hardly disguise foolishness and ineptitude.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: GET! LOST!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I wish to bridge the gap to the other side. I know what you seek...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I will reveal hidden secrets.

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: Seriously, are you sick or something?

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Must have forgotten to take his meds.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Ah, to be blind and foolish.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: The weapons from Columbia bring unfathomable destruction and power.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: They await their destined bearer.

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Farewell.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Get lost, and never come back!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Ealayk allaena!

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: What's your problem? Outta my way!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: What did he say? Weapons from Columbia?

steps.name: Young Mercenary
steps.text: How would I know?! Piss off!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Columbian weapons...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) One more mug!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) *Hic* The people here...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) Dumb *hic* peasants...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) They *hic* have no idea *hic* about the stuff I have!

steps.name: Barkeeper
steps.text: I think you've had too much.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) Idiots! *Hic*

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) I thought I could *hic* make a killing off it...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) The stuff's so good *hic*... why won't anyone take it?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Hey there, friend.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) *Hic*...
Hey!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Who's there?!
I saw you shadowing him.
What are you up to?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Allaenat ealayk!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: None of your business!
What are you up to?!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Out of my way!
Ugh...
Help! Thief!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Allaenat ealayk!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) Huh? *Hic* What d'ya want?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You're coming with me.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: (Drunkenly) Ow!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: This is... my room...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: How did I...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: W-Who are you?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You're awake? Where are the goods?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: W-What goods?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Don't play dumb with me. You've been telling anyone who would listen that you have a bunch of Columbian weapons.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You wanted to do business. Well, I'm here to do business.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Business...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Who the hell does business like this?!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: I want to see a sample. Now.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Business is all about trust. I'm sure you understand.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Behind that cupboard.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Ow! Why you—!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Aren't you gonna show me a sample? Is this how you treat your customers?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: No wonder you couldn't sell anything.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (Even project leads like my brother couldn't have taken experimental weapons out of the labs, much less sold them abroad.)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (So who is this man? Is he really just elaborate bait?)

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: (The terrible acting, the obvious lies...)

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Here... your sample.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Well, well! Very fine indeed.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: O-Of course! It's cutting-edge technology!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Simple to maintain, and, er... easy to use.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Even for laymen...

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Show me how.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: W-What?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: But I'm not a mercenary...

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: So what? Didn't you say it's easy to use?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: It's your product. You demonstrate it.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Allaenat ealayk!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Don't point that thing at me! I'll kill you!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I-I think it's this one here...?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You don't even know how use your own goods?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I-I do! I do!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Activate the Originium... then press the trigger.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: I told you not to point that thing at me!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Allaenat ealayk!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Enough!!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Don't touch me again! I'm warning you!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Al'ama! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Down payment! You wanna do business, you make a down payment!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: You want money? You haven't shown me any goods!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: This weapon is really powerful!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: All you need to do is press the trigger! Wanna see for yourself?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: How many do you have? The same model as the one you're holding?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: T-Tons of 'em!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I'll have someone tell you where the deal takes place once I get my down payment!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: How do I know you're not playing me for a fool?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: You saw it with your own eyes!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: The form, the technology, none of this is possible in Sargon.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Alright, friend, I suppose did get a little carried away.

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: How much are you asking?

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Ibn al kalb! You're trying to threaten me?!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: I'll kill you!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Ow ow ow!
Don't move, unless you want to die.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: W-What?
That weapon won't help you. I know it better than you do.
Who are you? Where did this sample come from?
One... two...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I'll talk, I'll talk!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I really am from Columbia...

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Allaenat ealayk!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Who hit me?!

steps.name: Arrogant Merchant
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: If you hadn't acted, the prototype would have overloaded and exploded, wiping away all traces.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But instead, you saved his life, without even ascertaining his identity.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: A bout of adventurism? Or simple sentimentality?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I'm not out to kill people. I just want to know the truth.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Did you find the answer you wanted?
You're an employee at that company?
I've had a lot of business dealings with them. But I've never seen you.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I-I'm just a low-level worker in Logistics and Maintenance. You probably never met me.
Logistics and Maintenance... how did you get the weapon?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: We're in charge of transporting and scrapping discarded prototypes.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I found this off the scrap heap.
Scrapped prototypes? How many more like this do you have?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: None! This is the only one!
That's not what you said earlier.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I-I was lying to him!
Oh?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: But I'm telling the truth now!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: There were only so many of them, and most were completely destroyed.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: My thinking was that the people here would never chase me down to Columbia, even if they never got the goods.
A few years back, your company claimed that an accident had occurred at the lab, preventing them from delivering a shipment.
Did that really happen?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: A few years back...

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Yeah, there was a serious accident at a lab.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: But I don't know what happened... we arrived on the scene afterward.
Did you notice anything unusual?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Hmm... Not really.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: But the company removed every piece of scrap from the scene in individual containers.
Individual containers? Where were they taken?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I really don't know! Honest!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Everyone was searched before we left, to make sure none of us took anything.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I swear I'm telling the truth!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Please, don't kill me!

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Did you spare his life out of a sense of conscience, or as a valuable lead?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: No need to feel embarrassed. None of us act without a reason.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Not that the results are always what we wanted.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: And is this what you wanted?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: To see me feeling lost, helpless, angry?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I just wanted to know the answer.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: To what?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: How far you would go for revenge.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: However far it takes.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Is that so?
What about the researchers?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: What?
Did any researchers from the lab survive the accident?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I-I don't think so...
(Deep breath)
Your department disposed of the bodies, didn't it? Where were they taken?
I heard from their families that they never saw the bodies. They were just told that they had died in the accident.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: The bodies...
(Deep breath)
Yes, the bodies!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: They were all sent to garbage disposal.
What?!

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: 'It always ends the same way.'

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: 'I tried my best. I always fail, but I'll do anything. Anything for some closure.' Isn't that right?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: No plots, no traps, no ulterior motives.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Maybe they have no interest in your investigation. Maybe they've completely forgotten about you.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Worthless.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What do you want from me?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: How far you will go for revenge?

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: I'm sorry! They were sent to garbage disposal!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Whether intact or damaged, they were all just... there was no order from above.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: We just disposed of them according to standard procedures.

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Please!

steps.name: Darrell
steps.text: Please, don't kill me!

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: You know it wasn't his fault. He's insignificant.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But you don't want to let anything go, no matter how slim the chance, how flimsy the link.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: As long as you achieve your purpose.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Vengeance is the eternal motif.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Like you? Burning down a whole city without any concern for those within?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I gave them time to evacuate.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Yes, you made the relatively correct choice in the circumstances, one that saved you face.
